det.updatesHint: Apply available system updates via Ansible.
det.agentDescription: The Shipyard Agent runs directly on the host and reports system information (CPU, RAM, disk, OS) to Shipyard in real time — no SSH connection required. This is more efficient and faster than legacy SSH polling. Update checks (OS, Docker images, custom) still run via SSH.
det.agentUpdateHint: Updates only the runner script/version and restarts the agent service. URL, token, and mode stay unchanged.
det.agentConfigureHint: Re-applies the currently set Shipyard URL/CA and restarts the agent service.
det.agentRemoveConfirm: Remove agent now? The host will fall back to legacy polling.
det.agentCaPemPlaceholder: Leave empty for publicly trusted HTTPS certificates. Paste the Shipyard CA/server certificate here for self-signed or private CA TLS.
det.checkingUpdatesHint: Container images are being checked against their registries.
det.checkingSystemUpdatesHint: Package sources are being refreshed and available system packages are being checked.
det.imageUpdatesChecked: Check complete: {{checked}} containers checked, {{available}} updates available.
det.noContainersHint: Docker or Podman is not installed or has no containers.
det.noCustomTasks: No custom update tasks configured yet.
det.taskTypeScriptDesc: Define the desired state yourself: one command reads the target version, another reads the installed version on the host.
det.taskTypeGithubDesc: Fetches the latest release version from GitHub and compares it with the check command output.
det.taskTypeTriggerDesc: Runs a check command and flags an update when the output exactly matches the trigger output.
det.taskCheckCommandHint: (optional) SSH command that outputs the installed version, e.g. immich --version
det.taskCheckCommandHintTrigger: SSH command whose trimmed output is compared exactly to the trigger output.
det.taskLatestCommandHint: SSH command that outputs the desired version, e.g. curl -s https://api.example.com/latest
det.taskTriggerOutputHint: Exact output that should mark the task as update available, e.g. AVAILABLE
det.taskUpdateCommandHint: (optional) Shell command or script URL (http/https is run as bash <(curl …))
det.taskUpdateCommandOptionalHint: Optional update command. Leave empty if this task should only monitor.
det.taskTriggerRequired: Check command and trigger output are required for this type
det.allUpToDate: All packages are up to date
det.offlineHint: This host is currently unreachable. Check the connection or refresh its status.

ipam.childNoDoubleCount: Child prefixes are included in their parent address space and are not counted twice.
ipam.prefixInventoryDescription: Review address spaces hierarchically, select them, and manage them in bulk.
ipam.globalSearch: Search all IPs, prefixes, hostnames, MAC addresses, and hosts…
ipam.searchEmpty: No IPAM records match this search.
ipam.searchMore: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} matches. Refine the search to narrow the result.
ipam.sourcePageDescription: Monitor and configure observed address inventories for the active environment.
ipam.prefixUnavailableDescription: The requested address space could not be loaded.
ipam.prefixLoadFailed: IPAM prefix could not be loaded
ipam.prefixLoadFailedDescription: Check the connection and whether the prefix still exists. No data was changed.
ipam.dhcpRangeHint: Only addresses inside this range receive the DHCP status. UniFi, pfSense, and Proxmox only report observations and do not determine this status.
ipam.dhcpStatusManagedHint: DHCP is assigned automatically from the prefix range and cannot be selected manually.
ipam.dhcpAddressHint: This address is shown as DHCP because it lies inside the configured prefix range.
ipam.syncProxmoxDescription: Guest addresses are read from the QEMU Guest Agent. Manually managed records and ranges remain unchanged.
ipam.syncConflictLoadFailed: Synchronization conflicts could not be loaded
ipam.emptyInventory: This prefix has no used addresses or ranges yet.
ipam.emptyFilter: No records match the current search or status filter.
ipam.inventoryOrder: Individual addresses and ranges in ascending IP order.
ipam.searchAllocations: Search address, host, MAC, or source…
ipam.releaseSelectedDescription: You are releasing {{count}} reserved address-space records. This action cannot be undone.
ipam.externalReleaseWarning: Some selected addresses are managed by external sources. They may be restored during the next synchronization.
ipam.syncConflictsDescription: The existing IPAM assignment was left unchanged. Check the source or correct the existing address before synchronizing again.
ipam.systemSourceTitle: Configured by the prefix and protected from direct changes.
ipam.nameDeviceDescription: This name is saved with the MAC address and follows the device when DHCP assigns a different IP address.
ipam.deletePrefixDescription: The prefix {{cidr}}, its {{addresses}} individual addresses, and {{ranges}} ranges will be deleted. Child prefixes remain and are reparented automatically. This cannot be undone.
ipam.editPrefixDescription: Update the configuration for {{cidr}}. CIDR changes require a new prefix so existing allocations cannot be moved accidentally.
ipam.name: Name
ipam.addPrefixDescription: Only name and CIDR are required. Child prefixes are assigned automatically based on their CIDR.
ipam.prefixStatusFailed: The prefix status could not be changed.
ipam.assignVlanDescription: Set the VLAN for {{count}} selected prefixes. Leave it empty to remove the assignment.
ipam.scanPrefixesDescription: Synchronize discovered Proxmox guests into the {{count}} selected prefixes.
ipam.deletePrefixesDescription: This also deletes reservations and ranges inside these prefixes.
ipam.proxmoxConnectionsFailed: Proxmox connections could not be loaded.
ipam.noProxmoxConnection: No Proxmox connection is available in this environment.
ipam.releaseRangeDescription: The reserved range {{range}} will be removed from IPAM.
ipam.releaseAddressDescription: The address {{address}} will be removed from IPAM.
ipam.sourceRestoreWarning: This address comes from {{source}}. It may be restored by the source during the next synchronization.
ipam.queryLoadDescription: IPAM data is currently unavailable. No changes were made.
ipam.directChildrenDescription: Address spaces directly below this prefix.
ipam.reserveSpaceDescription: Add a single address or reserve a contiguous range. Detail fields remain in the selected form.
ipam.rangePurposePlaceholder: e.g. DHCP pool, printers, or reserve
ipam.rangeObjectHint: The range is managed as one IPAM object and appears together with individual addresses in the address space.
ipam.changeAddressDescription: Change the core data, assignment, and status of this address.
ipam.syncedEditWarning: Hostname, MAC address, status, and description may be updated by the source during the next synchronization. Maintain these values permanently in the source.
ipam.pfsenseSetupInstall: Install the compatible pfSense REST API community package for your exact pfSense version.
ipam.pfsenseSetupKey: In System → REST API, enable API-key authentication and create a key for a dedicated user.
ipam.pfsenseSetupAccess: Grant that user only GET access to the DHCP server leases endpoint and allow the Shipyard server to reach pfSense over HTTPS (TCP 443).
ipam.pfsenseReadOnlyHint: Shipyard only sends GET requests to /api/v2/status/dhcp_server/leases. Testing never changes IPAM data; synchronization only updates Shipyard's local IPAM and does not modify pfSense.
ipam.sourceDescription: Controllers provide observed inventory. Active sources are synchronized automatically into existing prefixes; manual reservations remain authoritative.
ipam.automaticMaintenanceDescription: Shipyard checks active sources on their interval and imports the current lease inventory. Test remains available without changing data. Source leases that are no longer reported are released; collisions are never overwritten.
ipam.sourcesLoadFailedDescription: Check the connection and try again before editing existing sources.
ipam.noSources: No external source configured yet. Add a UniFi controller or pfSense firewall to import its lease inventory in a controlled way.
ipam.tokenKeepHint: Leave the token empty to keep the existing token.
ipam.credentialsHint: Credentials are stored encrypted and never displayed in the browser.
ipam.sourceRemoved: Source and its synchronized lease records removed.
ipam.confirmSyncDescription: Shipyard imports the current lease inventory from {{name}}. Managed IPs no longer reported by this source will be released. Manual reservations and data from other sources remain unchanged.
ipam.confirmRemoveSourceDescription: The source {{name}} and its {{count}} synchronized lease records will be removed. Manual reservations, Proxmox syncs, and other sources remain unchanged.
ipam.sourceReachable: {{name}} is reachable. The test did not change any IPAM data.
ipam.outsidePrefixWarning: These addresses are not within a configured prefix. They will not be imported until a matching prefix exists.
ipam.noUsableLeases: The source was reachable but returned no usable IPv4 leases.
ipam.reviewSyncHint: Review the matches, then start a complete synchronization. Only source leases from this source are updated; manual reservations remain unchanged.
